name: latch
title: A push-push latch: press, it stays down; press again, it comes back up. A pin on a leaf round a heart-shaped track
orientation: On its side, as drawn: one piece, no supports. Press the button: the pin on its leaf runs down the track's right side and, let go, rises into the heart's cleft and holds the button down. Press again: the pin leaves the cleft to the left and, let go, runs up the left side home.

body.label: The latch: frame and track, guide, plunger, leaf and pin in one print

height.rule: How tall it prints: the flexures' width

gap.rule: The least gap that prints apart

round.rule: Rounds where flexures meet blocks, and on every inside corner

into.rule: How far a leaf runs into the block it grows from

guide_len.rule: The plunger's guide leaves: long, for its stroke within the strain limit

guide_t.rule: The guide leaves' thickness at their ends

taper.rule: How far the guide leaves taper towards their middles

button.rule: How far the plunger stands up out of the frame: the button

leaf_len.rule: The leaf the pin hangs on: long and soft, so the pin swings across the track easily, and it pulls the pin back to the middle

side.rule: How far either side of the middle the track's channels run

roof.rule: How far down the pin goes before the roof sends it right

drop.rule: How far the roof falls across, from its apex to the right channel

cleft.rule: How far down the pin is held, in the heart's cleft

stroke.rule: How far a press drives the pin down

lean.rule: How far the cleft's way in and way out sit either side of the middle, so a press from the cleft goes left

band.rule: Room either side of the pin's path, for the leaf's give

press_most.rule: The most a press may take

up.rule: The leaf hangs straight down from the plunger
